# Tiny public fixtures — bacterial PKS marker-debug

These fixtures are public bacterial reference-region examples for the B2 Phase 2 first-trial marker-debug patch.

- `BGC0002086` — Micromonospora rosamicin/macrolide-like PKS seed.
- `LC529898.1` — Streptomyces nobilis desertomycin BGC seed.

Purpose: test conservative support/caution marker detection without globally enabling HMM/DIAMOND/BLASTP Phase 2 backends or changing scoring.
